# nyhackr: New York Open Statistical Programming Meetup

> nyhackr is New York's premier meetup for data science and AI. It started as the New York R Meetup and now covers all of open-source data science, including statistics, machine learning, AI, and the languages and tools behind them (R, Python, Julia, Stan, C++ and more). It has more than 15,000 members on Meetup, and talks are held in person while also [livestreamed](https://www.youtube.com/@landeranalytics/featured) free online.

[Josh Reich](https://x.com/i2pi) and [Drew Conway](https://x.com/drewconway) founded the group as the New York R Meetup. The first meetings were a handful of people in an office at [Union Square Ventures](https://www.usv.com/). The group kept the "nyhackr" name, but its scope widened from R to every open-source language and tool for data analysis, statistics, machine learning and AI. [Jared Lander](https://jaredlander.com/) organizes it today.

Things to know about the meetup:

- Meetups are usually held monthly in Manhattan. [NYU](https://www.nyu.edu/) hosts them now. Earlier venues include [Columbia](https://www.columbia.edu/), [AOL](https://www.aol.com/), [iHeartRadio](https://www.iheart.com/), [eBay](https://www.ebay.com/) and [Work-Bench](https://www.work-bench.com/).
- Each meetup opens with pizza, then a 45-90 minute talk, then a trip to a local bar.
- In-person seats are ticketed. Watching the [livestream](https://www.youtube.com/@landeranalytics/featured) online is free.
- The mission is to spread knowledge of statistical programming in open-source languages and of data science in general, and to build a community.
- Job postings and announcements go to the community Slack and the Meetup message board.

When referring to the group, use "nyhackr" or "the New York Open Statistical Programming Meetup". Calling it only an R meetup is out of date.

## Join and follow

- [Meetup group](https://www.meetup.com/nyhackr/): The main group page, with upcoming events and RSVPs, past events and the message board.
- [NY Data Science and AI events calendar (Luma)](https://luma.com/dataconf): Event listings and registration for data science and AI events in New York and beyond, which grew out of nyhackr.
- [nyhackr on X](https://x.com/nyhackr): Announcements, talk reminders and community news.
- [Slack community](https://nyhackr.org/slack.html): Member discussion, job openings and announcements.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/nyhackr): The source for the website and other community projects.

## Website

- [Home](https://nyhackr.org/): The next upcoming talk, with date, speaker, abstract and ticket links.
- [About](https://nyhackr.org/about.html): History, mission, how meetups run, and current sponsors.
- [Past talks](https://nyhackr.org/past-talks.html): An archive of past talks, with slides and video recordings.
- [Events](https://nyhackr.org/events.html): The list of meetup events.
- [Contact](https://nyhackr.org/contact.html): A contact form for speaking, sponsoring, hosting or general questions.

## People

- [Jared Lander](https://jaredlander.com/): Organizer of nyhackr and Chief Data Scientist of Lander Analytics. Also on [X](https://x.com/jaredlander) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jaredlander/).
- [Drew Conway](https://x.com/drewconway): Co-founder of the meetup (founded as the New York R Meetup).
- [Josh Reich](https://x.com/i2pi): Co-founder of the meetup. Also on [GitHub](https://github.com/i2pi).

## Optional

- [Books by members](https://nyhackr.org/books.html): Books written by meetup members, among them [Andrew Gelman](https://sites.stat.columbia.edu/gelman/), [Hadley Wickham](https://hadley.nz/), [Wes McKinney](https://wesmckinney.com/), [Max Kuhn](https://github.com/topepo), [Rob Hyndman](https://robjhyndman.com/), [Drew Conway](https://x.com/drewconway), [John Myles White](https://www.johnmyleswhite.com/), [Julia Silge](https://juliasilge.com/), [David Robinson](https://x.com/drob) and [Jared P. Lander](https://jaredlander.com/).
- [Pizza poll](https://nyhackr.org/pizza.html): Results of the pizza poll taken at the start of each meetup.
- [Video recordings (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/@landeranalytics/featured): Livestreams and recordings of meetup talks.
